description: This file defines a custom exception class 'MigrationException' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Installer\Exception'. It provides a static method to generate the exception with a specific message indicating incomplete previous migration.

classes.name: MigrationException
classes.description: A custom exception class for migration-related errors, extending PHP's base Exception class and adding a static method for a specific error condition.

methods.name: previousMigrationIncomplete
methods.description: A static method that returns an instance of MigrationException with a message indicating that the previous migration is incomplete.

calls: new self('The previous migration is incomplete.')
